knowledge_gaps: The experiment is not reproducible yet: baseline and alternative α, prefix sampling, mask corruption, loss reduction, checkpoint selection, and GPU-budget allocation are unspecified. These baseline details require host implementation evidence.

Terminal-only examples contain fewer supervised positions than random-mask examples. Changing α can change both objective alignment and effective supervision; the report needs an explicit loss-weighting policy and supervised-token counts.

The target-visibility audit needs refinement: repeated occurrences of the target item in earlier history are legitimate context. Some masked-language-model corruption schemes also intentionally retain selected input tokens. Audit accidental leakage against the declared corruption policy rather than requiring blanket target absence.

The diagnostic adapter remains underspecified. It needs supervised-position identification, valid negative-item checks, sample counts, unavailable-value handling, and restoration of model mode and random-generator state so diagnostics do not alter training.

Average embedding cosine measures directional alignment, not collapse comprehensively. The potential score of 8 is optimistic without baseline evidence; terminal-mask tuning is incremental and does not directly establish improved compatibility or immediate-choice relevance.
